description: This source file defines the class 'SavingsAccountTransactionDetailsForPostingPeriod', which encapsulates detailed information about transactions related to savings accounts within a specific posting period. It provides methods to determine transaction timing, calculate end-of-day balances, and check transaction inclusion within date intervals.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDetailsForPostingPeriod
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a savings account transaction within a particular posting period, including methods for balance calculations and period checks.

methods.name: fallsWithin
methods.description: Checks if the transaction's balance interval falls within a given period interval.

methods.name: spansAnyPortionOf
methods.description: Determines if the transaction's balance interval overlaps with a given period interval.

methods.name: occursOn
methods.description: Checks if the transaction occurs on a specific date.

methods.name: toEndOfDayBalance
methods.description: Calculates the end-of-day balance based on the transaction and an opening balance.

methods.name: toEndOfDayBalance
methods.description: Calculates the end-of-day balance considering a specific period interval and currency.

methods.name: toEndOfDayBalanceBoundedBy
methods.description: Calculates the end-of-day balance bounded within a specified date interval, adjusting for transactions and balance boundaries.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the transaction amount as a Money object in the specified currency.
